subject: An explanation may be eliminated only within the scope actually tested.
rationale: S004 grounds elimination in important inconsistencies with observed evidence, while S005 identifies limitations that can undermine those comparisons. T001 describes incomplete package tracking, limited monitoring capacity and differing delivery and receiving conditions. These justify restricting elimination to the cases and explanatory scope tested: a contradiction for one package or circumstance does not exclude that mechanism elsewhere. This restriction does not assert that any explanation has been eliminated or that testing alone suffices for elimination.
